result.a_prediction_i_got_wrong: I recorded earlier that the missing Metal developer toolchain was the blocker for building the seed. It is NOT. The seed builds fine without it, and the FAILURES are caused by the host clang lacking an NVPTX target -- a different tool entirely. The Metal toolchain accounts for SKIPS, not failures. I had asserted the wrong cause from a plausible-sounding inference and only running it exposed that.

claim_boundary: P1 is SUBSTANTIALLY REPRODUCED, not fully. The pinned seed clones at the exact commit, configures, builds with zero errors, and passes 198 of its own 216 tests. It is NOT fully reproduced: 18 tests fail and 148 skip, and no CUDA source has been compiled end to end on this machine. Both remaining blockers are MISSING TOOLCHAINS that could be installed, NOT platform walls, and neither has been characterised as one. This says nothing about P2: no NVIDIA hardware exists, so no differential against real CUDA has been run and none of the seed's output has been compared to an NVIDIA reference.
